findings.issue_summary: **User-Initiated Collection**: Disclosure exempt, but **must be declared** in Play Store form.
findings.evidence: Chat messages (OTHER_MESSAGES) are transferred off-device via the httpPost("/api/chat/history") in ChatViewModel.kt, which stores them in Redis via saveChatHistory in ChatService.ts. Since the collection occurs actively when the user sends messages, it is user-initiated and exempt from prominent disclosure, but must still be declared.
findings.recommendation: Declare OTHER_MESSAGES in the Play Store Data Safety section as collected for App Functionality.
